controls.scope: Original ScoreGazette and sniff_id_type definitions with real NumPy, synthetic classifier/featurizer. No learned-model/full-package or arbitrary identifier qualification.

findings: Original scoring converts string identifiers to NumPy Unicode width256; two distinct 257-character identifiers collide in a finite original-method control.
Score worker queue uses two batches and default batch20000; this is not a hard memory budget because feature width and worker count also matter.
Missing distances become zero with optional missingness-indicator columns; this is feature policy rather than exact equality.
Serializer uses tagged tuple/frozenset dictionaries; arbitrary record fields matching reserved tags need roundtrip validation before reuse.
limits: No full-package import, learned model or upstream test run.
Synthetic scorer controls do not qualify classifier accuracy.
No production code adopted into rrrah.
